mapper.select: select template_id, event_type, entry_seq, direction, subject_code, subject_name, auxiliary_type, summary_template, status, create_by, create_time from fin_voucher_template where template_id = #{templateId}

select template_id, event_type, entry_seq, direction, subject_code, subject_name, auxiliary_type, summary_template, status, create_by, create_time from fin_voucher_template where event_type = #{eventType} and status = '0' order by entry_seq asc
mapper.insert: insert into fin_voucher_template ( event_type, entry_seq, direction, subject_code, subject_name, auxiliary_type, summary_template, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{eventType}, #{entrySeq}, #{direction}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, coalesce(#{auxiliaryType}, 'none'), coalesce(#{summaryTemplate}, ''), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), coalesce(#{createBy}, 'admin'), sysdate() )
mapper.select: select e.entry_id, e.voucher_event_id, e.voucher_no, e.entry_seq, e.direction, e.subject_code, e.subject_name, e.auxiliary_type, e.auxiliary_name, e.debit_amount, e.credit_amount, e.summary, e.create_time, coalesce(v.voucher_date, v.event_date) as voucher_date, v.bill_no from fin_voucher_entry e left join fin_voucher_event v on v.voucher_event_id = e.voucher_event_id where e.voucher_event_id = #{voucherEventId} order by e.entry_id asc, e.entry_seq asc

select entry_id, voucher_event_id, voucher_no, entry_seq, direction, subject_code, subject_name, auxiliary_type, auxiliary_name, debit_amount, credit_amount, summary, create_time from fin_voucher_entry where voucher_event_id = #{voucherEventId} and voucher_no = #{voucherNo} order by entry_seq asc, entry_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into fin_voucher_entry ( voucher_event_id, voucher_no, entry_seq, direction, subject_code, subject_name, auxiliary_type, auxiliary_name, debit_amount, credit_amount, summary, create_time ) values ( #{voucherEventId}, #{voucherNo}, #{entrySeq}, #{direction}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, coalesce(#{auxiliaryType}, 'none'), coalesce(#{auxiliaryName}, ''), coalesce(#{debitAmount}, 0), coalesce(#{creditAmount}, 0), coalesce(#{summary}, ''), sysdate() )
